normal.sampling: Original B exact integer quotas; fixed new domain salt
normal.fallback_registered_for_future_K_below_C: Hash sample K components, one UID each; expansion C*N_g/K

attack.quota_donor: Largest current quota above floor; fixed stratum-order ties
attack.source_scope: Pinned scenario/direction establishes eligible population; within-population ranking uses only header strata and physical UID

storage_lower_bound.caution: Not a full disk budget; add original context state, metadata, checkpoint, decode and temporary files

resizing.f: K/20000 applied identically to all three role quotas; references remain4124
resizing.criterion: Select largest K whose conservative measured complete pipeline estimate fits24h; include decode/context/shape batches/references/distances/I/O/resume

reporting.sample_rate: Exact errors/selected rows, explicitly sample ratio
reporting.population_estimate: Inverse inclusion weights divided by known full N; do not renormalize or clamp HT point estimate
reporting.normal_component_metric: All components equal within B branch; sampled-component estimate in fallback

temporal_sensitivity.anchor: Original captured minimum timestamp within each pinned capture/scenario
temporal_sensitivity.blocks: Enumerate entire eligible population blocks, including zero-selected blocks; never mix capture/scenario boundaries
temporal_sensitivity.label: Conditional temporal sensitivity interval, not proof of full sampling-design95% coverage
